critique: All motion ends by 2.67s and the last 3.3s is a dead static hold; the value labels only fade and drift instead of counting up, so the data reveal feels flat and front-loaded.

Stretch the build across the 6s with a slower stagger and longer bar grows, have each value count up from 0 in sync with its bar, and give Q4 a stronger, later accent beat (overshoot settle plus a color or glow shift) that resolves into a short end hold.
